exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "B is more ~ than A".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない
A より B のほうが〜
options.romaji: A yori B no hou ga 〜

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! A より B のほうが〜 matches "B is more ~ than A".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is A より B のほうが〜.
exercises.explanation: Used to show that B has more of a quality than A in comparisons.
